title: Mirror Phrase
description: Given a lowercase string, determine whether it reads the same from left to right and right to left.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; the string contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: the string.
outputFormat: Print YES if the string is symmetric, otherwise print NO.
hints: Compare characters from both ends and move toward the center.

examples.explanation: The string is identical when read in either direction.
The characters from the two ends do not match.
